question: Which physiographic division covers a distance of 2500 km from Indus to Brahmaputra in west-east direction?
solution:
The correct answer is '__**Himalayan mountains'.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** ****The Himalayan Mountains**

 
 
• The Himalayas are the young fold mountains.
 
• They run from the west-east direction from Indus to Brahmaputra covering a distance of 2500 KM.
 
• Their width varies from 400 in the west and 150 KM in the East.
 
• The Himalayas may be divided into three parallel ranges:
